name: motion-canvas-hop
title: Infinite Canvas Jump
description: Trên một bảng vẽ vô tận, máy quay lùi ra cho thấy toàn cảnh, bay ngang từ khung A sang khung B rồi đẩy vào sát khung B, kèm bản đồ thu nhỏ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.from: [x, y] world px of frame A
options.to: [x, y] of frame B (3120 px across, 660 down: 520 / 110 of the small demo × 6)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Canvas with frames A and B 520 px apart (110 px vertically), dotted grid and filler cards. The camera centre moves A to B over 1.8 s power2.inOut (0.45-2.25 s) while zoom = 2 × 0.21^(sin(π u)) (u = eased progress): 2× at both ends, 0.42× at the midpoint, so it pulls out, travels and pushes in. Optional minimap (78x38) with the viewport rectangle. Demo fades to dark 3.55-3.85 s to loop. Params: zoom (2× → 0.42× → 2×) · duration (1.8 s, power2.inOut) · from / to: khung A, khung B · minimap.
moworks.titleVi: Máy quay lùi ra, bay sang, đẩy vào
